variant.author: Miu-B
variant.changelog:
- Add multi-folder monitoring: configure up to 5 folders simultaneously (e.g. Steam Game Recording + OBS output)
- Fix OBS indicator flashing caused by buffered writes (poll grace period + increased inactivity timeout)
- Redesigned config window with per-folder Browse/Remove and Add Folder button
- Automatic config migration from single-folder to multi-folder format

variant.author: Miu-B
variant.changelog:
- Two new appearance toggles has been added.
- Show teleport icon only will remove the teleport text and add just the aetheryte crystal as a clickable teleport link.
- Show clock icon only will remove the walk hint text if enabledand add just the clock icon when walking would be quicker without showing the text.
